meta.name: market-landscape-scan
meta.description: Map a market's segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with cited evidence. Use when entering or re-evaluating a market before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制市场格局，识别细分、玩家与空白机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在进入或重新评估一个市场，需要结构化全景图
copy.tagline_en: Map market segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering or re-evaluating a market and need a structured landscape overview

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按流程扫描市场：先问最多3个问题（市场、决策、边界），然后制定搜索计划，接着研究并输出一份市场格局快照，包含细分、玩家、动态、空白区和下一步建议。
howto.when: 当你需要进入或重新评估一个市场，在做市场规模估算、定位或选择竞争对手之前触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描合同分析工具的市场格局，支持我们进入这个市场的决策。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问并执行扫描流程。

say.text: 分析欧洲开发者API可观测性工具的市场，用于Q4市场进入决策。
say.note: Claude 会按指定边界和决策进行扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will scan a market by following a workflow: ask up to 3 questions (market, decision, boundary), create a search plan, research, and output a landscape snapshot with segments, players, dynamics, whitespace, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Trigger when entering or re-evaluating a market, before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

say_en.text: Map the contract analytics tooling market to support our entry decision.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions and execute the scan.

say_en.text: Scan the EU developer API observability tools market for a Q4 entry decision.
say_en.note: Claude will scan with the specified boundary and decision.
